Commission a targeted /lit-pull on expected magnitude and timescale of waking metacognitive overconfidence drift under sleep deprivation/fatigue in the human/mammalian literature, to judge whether the asymmetric-EMA form -- if H1/H2 are ruled out -- is even the right FUNCTIONAL FORM, independent of parameter tuning.
